observation: The city was visually useful but sluggish with hundreds of independent meshes, shadows and per-file lights
decision: Replace repeated objects with GPU instances and remove decorative work

observation: Two instanced skyline draws, merged directory geometry, capped pixel density and demand rendering were reported as snappy in the same trial
decision: Keep performance as a first-order semantic constraint

observation: Root files, src and packages required visible separation without becoming three unrelated distant worlds
decision: Use adapter-defined campus slabs with a controlled void

observation: Walls alone did not communicate nested depth reliably
decision: Use raised terraces and keep folder labels on visible faces

observation: The browser repeatedly showed stale source despite hard reloads
decision: Alias the workspace package to first-party source; verify revisions 002 to 003 on one open page without restart

observation: Showing only selected imports while greying unrelated buildings and slabs made local evidence readable
decision: Keep full graph hidden by default

observation: A declared package dependency could exist without a direct import because of load order or dependency injection
decision: Distinguish import, injection, capability, load-order and unresolved declaration evidence

observation: Revision 035 recorded 2392 imports, 71 injections and 83 declarations; build, lint, 538 client tests and 11 focused server tests passed
decision: Retain a finite framework-neutral connection vocabulary and keep unresolved endpoints explicit

observation: Repeated use of a shared export produced an unreadable web
decision: Aggregate at owned directory collection points and expose exact last-mile files on demand

observation: A badly bounded subsystem could have several physical fragments
decision: Draw one collection point per proven fragment rather than inventing a single physical home

observation: Small vertical offsets looked like layout nudges rather than software layers; five cumulative levels were subsequently implemented but not fully evaluated
decision: Use discrete planes separated by enough void to preserve the layered meaning; retain implementation and evaluation as separate claims
